baal recast as 'a man that is given to' is rule 43's noun-of-possession case, where the supplied antecedent, relative and predicate of having all belong to that noun's unit; contrast PRO.22.9, where no noun of possession stands and the supplied 'hath' is added.
The prohibitive al takes the determiner its negation has become ('no friendship'), under rule 15's recast-negation sentence.
